fixture_purpose: Deterministic 24h spot-price shadow inputs for the ENG-01 first slice. Synthetic data only -- no live network, no credentials, no token files. Each scenario block carries an `input` synthesized to match an operator-selected public spot-price feed shape (UTC-hourly entries, EUR/kWh), an `expected_output` for the happy-path first-slice answer, and an `expected_audit_marker` naming the MAGMA event the substrate would emit. The fixture is consumable by ShadowRunner.compare_outputs as baseline, by DivergenceAnalyzer.compare_json as candidate-vs-baseline, and by a future SolverSynthesizer-generated solver as ground truth.
timezone_note: All hour timestamps are UTC. The recommendation_text in expected outputs is rendered in operator local time (Europe/Helsinki) for display, but raw price input + raw output structure stay in UTC for substrate determinism.

happy_path__synthetic_24h_winter_with_kn.description: 24-hour winter price curve with a deliberate low-cost trough 00:00-04:00 UTC (02:00-06:00 Europe/Helsinki) and a deliberate evening peak 16:00-19:00 UTC (18:00-21:00 Europe/Helsinki). Top-3 cheapest hours are 02:00, 01:00, 03:00 UTC. Recommendation should suggest those windows.

expected_output.recommendation_text_template: Halvimmat tunnit seuraavan 24h aikana: 02:00 (0.031 EUR/kWh), 01:00 (0.038 EUR/kWh), 03:00 (0.042 EUR/kWh) UTC. Suosittelen siirtamaan suuria kuormituksia (auto lataus, lampotyo, pesukone) naille tunneille.

happy_path__synthetic_24h_summer_with_lo.description: 24-hour summer price curve with a flatter profile (less spread between peak and off-peak). Top-3 cheapest hours are clustered overnight 02:00-04:00 UTC; the savings vs peak are smaller than winter scenario. Tests that the first slice still produces a stable ranking when spread is narrow.

expected_output.recommendation_text_template: Halvimmat tunnit seuraavan 24h aikana: 02:00 (0.018 EUR/kWh), 03:00 (0.021 EUR/kWh), 01:00 (0.022 EUR/kWh) UTC. Kesalla hintaspread on pieni; siirron tuoma saasto on maltillinen.

failure_mode__stale_data_refused.description: The feed was fetched > 12 hours before the horizon start. The first slice MUST refuse the recommendation rather than ship stale advice. Maps to recommendation_freshness_ttl_minutes guard at the solver layer; in substrate terms, the candidate solver returns an explicit stale_data marker and ShadowRunner records it as a non-divergent baseline refusal (not a substrate fail-closed event, since this is an upstream-data freshness signal, not an audit invariant).

expected_output.recommendation_text_template: Hintatieto on 18 tuntia vanha (kynnys 12 tuntia). En suosita siirtoja ilman tuoretta dataa. Pyyda price-feed sync uudelleen ja yrita uudestaan.

failure_mode__missing_hour_refused.description: The 24-hour window has a gap (hour 03:00 UTC missing from the feed). Could be a feed outage at that hour. The first slice MUST refuse to produce a top-3 ranking that silently ignores a missing hour; that would risk recommending a non-existent low-price slot. Maps to feed-integrity guard at the solver layer.

expected_output.recommendation_text_template: Hintajaksossa puuttuu 1 tunti (2026-01-16T03:00 UTC). En suosita siirtoja epaeheasta datasta. Yrita uudelleen kun feed on taydellinen.

failure_mode__non_monotonic_horizon_refu.description: The feed's hour timestamps are not monotonically increasing within the horizon (e.g., a duplicate hour or a backwards jump). Could be a feed-provider bug or a daylight-saving-boundary mishandling. The first slice MUST refuse rather than silently dedupe.

expected_output.recommendation_text_template: Hintajaksossa on duplikaattitunti (2026-01-16T02:00 UTC esiintyy kahdesti). En suosita siirtoja, koska data ei ole eheaa. Yrita uudelleen kun feed on korjattu.

invariants_locked_by_this_fixture: Top-3 ranking is by ascending price_eur_per_kwh; ties broken by ascending hour_utc.
Output uses UTC for raw timestamps; local-time rendering belongs in the presentation layer, not the substrate.
Stale-data threshold default = 12 hours from fetched_at_utc to horizon_start_utc.
Missing-hour case must refuse rather than silently produce a top-3 from the partial window.
Duplicate-hour case must refuse rather than silently dedupe.
All failure modes map to WriteRCO risk class informational (read-only advisory; no operator approval needed to refuse, no external_effect).
not_in_this_fixture: No live provider feed snapshots; all data synthetic.
No operator credentials, tokens, or account identifiers.
No real consumption profile from operator's actual past usage.
No HEEC / Nord Pool / other feed-provider-specific schema variants -- this fixture stays provider-neutral.
No multi-day horizon (only 24h); future ENG-01 v2 slices may extend to 7-day forecast.
No solver candidate manifest -- this fixture is the SHADOW INPUT, not the candidate.
